def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows = {r for r in range(h) if grid[r][0] == 1 or grid[r][w - 1] == 1}
    cols = {c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] == 1 or grid[h - 1][c] == 1}
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 2 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while stack:
                rr, cc = stack.pop()
                comp.append((rr, cc))
                for nr, nc in ((rr-1,cc),(rr+1,cc),(rr,cc-1),(rr,cc+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == 2 and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                        seen.add((nr,nc)); stack.append((nr,nc))
            rmin = min(rr for rr,cc in comp); rmax = max(rr for rr,cc in comp)
            cmin = min(cc for rr,cc in comp); cmax = max(cc for rr,cc in comp)
            row_hit = any(rr in rows for rr,cc in comp)
            col_hit = any(cc in cols for rr,cc in comp)
            row_interior = any(rmin < rr < rmax and any(x == rr for x,y in comp) for rr in rows)
            col_interior = any(cmin < cc < cmax and any(y == cc for x,y in comp) for cc in cols)
            if row_interior or col_interior or (row_hit and col_hit):
                for rr,cc in comp: out[rr][cc] = 1
    for r in rows:
        for c in range(w): out[r][c] = 1
    for c in cols:
        for r in range(h): out[r][c] = 1
    return out
